choice.source_protocol: Labeled development-selected configuration, not a label-free selector or untouched independent test. Full scores and non-development complement; ADE uses training development. Kev is an additional frozen pretrained language prior.

boundary: RGB resize, all encodings, alias aggregation, coupled writeback, original-size restoration and CPU prediction. Decode/init/offline language and development search excluded. Seven deterministic images and seven repeats; not full-dataset mean.
